svg.desc: 1093 commits across five public projects, 76 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-07-24 through 2026-10-15 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-15T00:58:56.865Z.
